This episode was an earnest attempt at tying the theme and narrative together in a Star Trek way. However, watching it I get the sense that 23rd century psychology seems to have regressed heavily for the sake of plot. And the heart stuff is awful. Their last episode, basically Mirror, Mirror: Part II was way more enjoyable, even though more derivative and fan-wanky.
